text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection list I3, which must be performed after 1000 operating hours 
as indicated by H1000 in the above titled block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel 
Azeem at 01 July 2003 , accepted by by eng. Mohamed Elasrrag General Manager, 
revised by EDEPCo. quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana, and approved by eng. 
Moneer Mahmoud El Wakeel Damietta CCPS Head Sector
Technical Specifications
 | Supplier | Caterpillar
 | Mode | Turbocharger with after 
 cooler.
 | Power | 2480 kw.
 | Speed | 1000 RPM
 | Generator rating | 2875 KVA.
 | Electric specifications | 6300 v & 3 PH & 50 HZ.
Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 appropriate personal protective equipment as
 safety helmet, 
 safety shoes,
 earplug, gloves pairs, breathing mask, safety 
 glasses
Be sure that the emergency diesel is out of service.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Measuring and checking tools.
Cleaning articles.
Magnetic pick up flexible.
Spray gun, Oil can.
Check injection fuel oil valve lashes 
 (clearances) between the rocker arm and the bridge and adjust.
Check valve bridge.
Check injection timing.
Check injection synchronization.
Clean crankcase breather system.
Clean and inspect oil filters.
Clean oil filters and replace damaged element 
 if it is required.
Clean primary fuel filters and drain water.
Take an oil sample to analyze it.
Inspect exhaust system and check for leaks.
Inspect air filter and check restriction.
Lubricate manual bearing device.
